fields.System.Title: RPL-101 — Set min and max per pick location
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want to set a minimum and maximum for a product at a pick
location, so that the system knows when to refill it and by how much.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a product and a pick location, then a rule with min and max quantities can be
  • created.
  • - Given a location that is not a pick face, then rule creation is rejected.
  • - Given an existing rule for that product and location, then a second is rejected.
  • - Given a rule, then it can be deactivated without being deleted.
  • - Given a rule change, then it is audited.
